children: BorgWarner EVP, Chief Administrative Officer and General Counsel Tonit Calaway will retire effective March 1, 2027, and consult for the company for one year.
Executive Vice President, Chief Administrative Officer, General Counsel and Secretary
Retirement under a transition agreement; consulting arrangement
Retirement: March 1, 2027; consulting period through March 1, 2028

Receives current $755,000 annual salary through retirement and a $62,917 monthly consulting fee. Eligible for 2026 bonus based on actual performance; no 2027 bonus or long-term incentive award. Equity treatment is subject to consulting service and agreement conditions.
